title: Top 15 OwnerRez Integrations for Vacation Rental Property Managers
summary: What the top OwnerRez integrations do and how each connects, from PriceLabs and Turno to Schlage locks, guest screening and owner expenses.
body_markdown:
Updated November 2026


OwnerRez runs your bookings, but it isn't where every job around a stay gets done. Someone updates rates for a holiday weekend. A cleaner needs to know when the guest checks out. A guest loses a key, and someone has to bill them for it.


If each of those tools stands apart from OwnerRez, someone on your team has to carry the details from one to the next.


Connecting them to OwnerRez solves that. OwnerRez lists its partners by category, from dynamic pricing and door locks to accounting and insurance, and most connect with a single authorization from the partner's app.


Every tool here is popular with vacation rental managers on OwnerRez and takes care of one core job. The order is only for reading, not a ranking. They're all good choices, and they work well together.


## Finance and Accounting


Owner expenses belong on owner statements, and company money belongs in the company books.


### 1. Topkey


Topkey is the AI-powered financial operating system built specifically for vacation rental managers. Integrating directly into OwnerRez and your accounting software, Topkey provides a single, unified system that automates expenses, bookkeeping, receipts, banking, corporate cards, AP/bill pay, inventory, and revenue reconciliation, so you can get back to what matters: hospitality. For OwnerRez users, it's how card charges and receipts become owner expenses, coded to the right property and owner. It's listed in OwnerRez's Accounting integrations.


How it works with OwnerRez.


Topkey syncs with OwnerRez and your accounting software, so the costs behind each property reach the owner's statement:


- Owner expenses.


Tag a card or bank charge in Topkey, and it posts to OwnerRez as an owner expense with the description, amount, receipt and your markup. Supplies checked out from inventory are tied to the right owner the same way.


- Property coding.


Topkey syncs your OwnerRez property and owner lists, so every expense is coded correctly without manual mapping.


- Guest surcharges.


A cost the guest caused, like a lost key or shipping a forgotten item, can post to OwnerRez as a surcharge on that guest's reservation.


- Field work.


Completed Breezeway tasks come into Topkey with their property details, so billable work gets billed.


Why it helps.


Every owner-billable charge lands on the owner's statement in OwnerRez with its receipt, and costs guests cause get billed back to them. Month-end close goes from days to hours, your team saves at least 25 hours a month, and owner billables go up 15% to 20%.


[Visit Topkey](https://topkey.io/integrations/ownerrez)


### 2. QuickBooks Online


QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud accounting software, and it's where many OwnerRez users keep their general ledger and financial reports.


How it works with OwnerRez.


OwnerRez's QuickBooks Integration is a premium add-on that pushes bookings, payments and bank deposits into QuickBooks Online automatically. Bookings become invoices, guest payments become received payments, and deposit syncing creates matching bank deposits. It works with QuickBooks Online only, not Desktop.


Why it helps.


Your books stay current without anyone retyping bookings, and synced deposits make bank reconciliation line up.


[Visit QuickBooks Online](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)


## Pricing and Revenue


Nightly rates should follow demand. Both of these set them for you and send them to OwnerRez as spot rates.


### 3. PriceLabs


PriceLabs is a dynamic pricing and revenue management platform that sets nightly rates and minimum stays from market data and your own rules.


How it works with OwnerRez.


You connect from PriceLabs and authorize the connection in OwnerRez. Each property needs an initial rate and a map location first. PriceLabs then sends daily rates and minimum stays to OwnerRez, 540 days ahead by default and up to 720 days.


Why it helps.


Your rates keep up with demand on every channel OwnerRez manages and on your OwnerRez booking site, without anyone editing the calendar.


[Visit PriceLabs](https://hello.pricelabs.co/integrations/ownerrez/)


### 4. Beyond


Beyond is a revenue management platform for short-term rentals that covers dynamic pricing and market data.


How it works with OwnerRez.


Beyond creates spot rates in OwnerRez every day, or whenever its pricing changes. By default it pushes minimum nights too, and you set minimum and maximum prices, gap fillers and last-minute discounts inside Beyond.


Why it helps.


Gap nights and last-minute openings get priced to fill, without someone watching the calendar every day.


[Visit Beyond](https://www.beyondpricing.com/)


## Operations and Housekeeping


These two keep turnovers on schedule, whether you run your own team or rely on independent cleaners.


### 5. Breezeway


Breezeway is a property care and operations platform for cleaning, inspections and maintenance, with checklists and photo proof from the field.


How it works with OwnerRez.


Once you authorize the connection, Breezeway runs an onboarding sync and pulls your OwnerRez reservations and block-offs automatically, so tasks are built around real stays.


Why it helps.


Cleaners, inspectors and techs work from the live booking calendar, and you can see each job was done before the next guest arrives.


[Visit Breezeway](https://www.breezeway.io/)


### 6. Turno


Turno is cleaning scheduling software with a marketplace of local cleaners.


How it works with OwnerRez.


Turno receives your OwnerRez reservations, guest counts and bedroom and bathroom counts instantly through webhooks. When a cleaner accepts or is assigned a job, Turno sends the cleaning date back to OwnerRez.


Why it helps.


Every checkout gets a cleaner on the schedule, and a backup from the marketplace is easy to find when someone cancels.


[Visit Turno](https://turno.com/)


## Access and Monitoring


Codes should start and stop with each booking, and you should hear about a party before the neighbors do.


### 7. RemoteLock


RemoteLock is cloud access control software that works with many smart lock brands.


How it works with OwnerRez.


OwnerRez generates a RemoteLock code every time a booking is created and cancels it when the booking is canceled. Every lock at the property gets the same code, and RemoteLock's ReadyPIN option keeps codes working when a lock is offline.


Why it helps.


Door codes take care of themselves, and RemoteLock covers lock brands OwnerRez doesn't connect to directly.


[Visit RemoteLock](https://remotelock.com/)


### 8. Schlage


Schlage makes the Encode line of Wi-Fi smart locks, which connect to Wi-Fi without a separate hub.


How it works with OwnerRez.


OwnerRez connects directly to Schlage Encode and Encode Plus locks, with no third-party service in between. You set up the lock in the Schlage Home app, then connect it in OwnerRez under Door Locks. Codes can be custom or the last digits of the guest's phone number.


Why it helps.


If your homes already have Schlage Encode locks, guests get automatic codes and you have one less account to manage.


[Visit Schlage](https://www.schlage.com/)


### 9. Minut


Minut makes noise, occupancy and temperature sensors for rentals that measure sound levels without recording conversations.


How it works with OwnerRez.


You link each Minut unit to its OwnerRez property, and Minut receives the guest's name, phone number and stay dates. When noise passes your threshold, Minut can text the guest who's staying.


Why it helps.


A noisy group gets a friendly reminder right away, before neighbors complain or damage happens.


[Visit Minut](https://www.minut.com/integrations/ownerrez)


## Guest Experience


Guests want the Wi-Fi password, the house rules and a dinner recommendation before they think to ask.


### 10. RueBaRue


RueBaRue is guest communication software built around digital guestbooks for vacation rentals.


How it works with OwnerRez.


RueBaRue imports your OwnerRez properties and reservations to build a guestbook for each home, with a house guide and a curated area guide. It sends guestbooks, surveys and thank-you notes by text or email on the schedule you choose.


Why it helps.


Guests have answers in their pocket, so fewer routine questions reach your phone.


[Visit RueBaRue](https://www.ruebarue.com/)


### 11. Enso Connect


Enso Connect is an AI guest experience platform with messaging, a branded guest app, digital check-in and upsells.


How it works with OwnerRez.


Enso connects through OwnerRez's official API. Listings, bookings and messages sync in near real time, usually in under two minutes, and replies to Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and Expedia guests go through OwnerRez.


Why it helps.


Guests check in and buy extras from their phone, and AI handles the routine questions so your team doesn't have to.


[Visit Enso Connect](https://ensoconnect.com/integrations/ownerrez)


## Screening and Protection


Screening keeps risky bookings out, and coverage handles the damage when something still goes wrong.


### 12. Safely


Safely provides vacation rental insurance and guest screening.


How it works with OwnerRez.


You authorize the connection from Safely's OwnerRez page, then add Safely's trust and safety fee as a surcharge in OwnerRez. Safely verifies each guest's identity and checks criminal databases, and its policy covers damage, injury and liability.


Why it helps.


A major claim doesn't depend on a homeowners policy that may not cover short-term rentals.


[Visit Safely](https://safely.com/)


### 13. Truvi


Truvi provides guest screening, damage protection and incident resolution for short-term rentals.


How it works with OwnerRez.


You connect from Truvi under Settings, then Integrations, then OwnerRez. Truvi then screens guests on new bookings automatically, using ID verification and biometric checks, and backs screened stays with damage protection.


Why it helps.


You can take direct bookings with more confidence, since every guest is screened no matter where they booked.


[Visit Truvi](https://truvi.com/)


## Data and Automation


One shows how you stack up against your market. The other connects OwnerRez to almost any app.


### 14. Key Data


Key Data is an analytics platform that compares your performance with anonymized, direct-sourced data from other managers in your market. It's the exclusive data partner of the Vacation Rental Management Association (VRMA).


How it works with OwnerRez.


After onboarding, you authorize Key Data in OwnerRez, and it pulls your reservation data directly, so there are no exports to manage.


Why it helps.


You can see whether you're ahead of or behind your market, which makes pricing calls and owner conversations easier to back up.


[Visit Key Data](https://www.keydatadashboard.com/)


### 15. Zapier


Zapier is a no-code automation platform that connects thousands of apps.


How it works with OwnerRez.


OwnerRez's Zapier app can start a workflow when a booking is created or updated, or when a contact changes. It can also write back to OwnerRez, like updating a booking or a custom field.


Why it helps.


Small jobs, like adding guests to your email list or logging bookings in a spreadsheet, run on their own.


[Visit Zapier](https://zapier.com/apps/ownerrez/integrations)


## How These Integrations Fit Together


A family books a lake house for the Fourth of July. PriceLabs priced the week. Truvi screened the guest. Schlage got a code built from the last digits of the guest's phone number. Turno put a cleaner on the schedule for checkout morning. Minut caught the late-night party and texted the guest. And when the family lost a key, Topkey billed it back as a surcharge on their OwnerRez reservation.


The owner's statement came out right the first time, and nobody chased a receipt.


You'll find all of these on OwnerRez's integrations page.


## OwnerRez Integrations FAQ


### What are OwnerRez integrations?


OwnerRez integrations are partner tools that connect to your OwnerRez account through its API. You usually start in the partner's app and authorize the connection in OwnerRez, and the two then share property, booking and guest data.


### Does OwnerRez integrate with QuickBooks?


Yes, with QuickBooks Online. OwnerRez's QuickBooks Integration is a premium add-on that syncs bookings, payments and bank deposits. It doesn't work with QuickBooks Desktop.


### What smart locks work with OwnerRez?


OwnerRez connects directly to Schlage Encode Wi-Fi locks. RemoteLock covers many other brands, and OwnerRez lists more door lock partners, including PointCentral.


### How do I bill owners for expenses in OwnerRez?


Record the cost as an owner expense on the property. Expense tools like Topkey create owner expenses from card and bank charges, with the receipt and markup included.


### Does OwnerRez work with PriceLabs?


Yes. PriceLabs sends daily rates and minimum stays to OwnerRez, 540 days ahead by default and up to 720 days.


### How do I prevent parties in an OwnerRez rental?


Pair guest screening, such as Truvi or Safely, with noise monitoring, such as Minut. Screening catches risky bookings before arrival, and Minut alerts the guest when noise runs high.


---


If owner expenses and receipts still get typed into OwnerRez by hand,
